summary.zh: 途中补充继续采集所需的弹药、能源或生命。
summary.en: Gather the supplies that keep the expedition itself running.

rules.zh: 部分资源不直接作为最终目标，而是转化为持续行动所需的补给。玩家在推进目标与维持工具、队伍续航之间切换；补给过少会迫使行动提前结束。
rules.en: Some resources are not final objectives but sustain tools or the team. Players alternate between goal progress and maintaining expedition capacity; insufficient supplies can end the outing early.

decisions.zh: 眼前就有目标资源，要不要先绕路补给？
decisions.en: Mine the nearby objective or detour for supplies first?

decisions.zh: 备用补给攒到多少才足够，何时变成无效囤积？
decisions.en: How much reserve is enough before stockpiling becomes wasted time?

effect.zh: 高转换率降低维护频率；低转换率可能让玩家一直在为采集而采集。
effect.en: High conversion reduces upkeep frequency; low conversion risks endless maintenance loops.

effect.zh: 补给与目标重叠使流程顺滑；分离分布制造明确路线取舍。
effect.en: Overlapping supplies and targets smooth the loop; separate distributions force route decisions.

implementation.zh: 硝石可用于呼叫补给舱，恢复队伍弹药与状态；即使不是本次任务的目标矿物，也需要关注。
implementation.en: Nitra is spent on resupply pods that restore team ammunition and condition, making it important even when it is not the mission objective.

observation.zh: 不同矿物分布在通行空间周围，补给资源与目标资源都需要绕路采集。系统参考图，未显示补给兑换。
observation.en: Different minerals surround traversal space, contextualizing supply detours. System reference; resupply conversion is not shown.

cases.rights: Ghost Ship Games / Coffee Stain Publishing

implementation.zh: 采矿光束需要能源，碳等材料可用于补充其能量；采集工具因此依赖沿途资源维持工作。
implementation.en: The Mining Beam needs energy and can be recharged with materials such as carbon, so gathering tools rely on resources found along the way.

observation.zh: 可采集植被与地表资源是行星工具续航的物资背景。系统参考图，未显示采矿光束充能。
observation.en: Harvestable vegetation and surface materials contextualize tool fuel. System reference; Mining Beam recharge is not shown.

contrast.zh: 深岩银河让补给资源服务整个团队的战斗续航；无人深空让燃料直接闭合采矿工具的能量循环。
contrast.en: Deep Rock feeds a team’s combat endurance; No Man’s Sky closes the energy loop of the mining tool itself.

combination.zh: 组合创意：采矿车用低级矿作燃料，高级矿负责收益；玩家可以临时烧掉货物自救，但会压低利润。
combination.en: Design proposal: a mining vehicle burns low-grade ore as fuel; valuable cargo can be sacrificed in an emergency at a profit cost.

setup.zh: 工具电量快用完，目标矿在前方，旁边能找到充电材料。
setup.en: Your tool is nearly empty; the target ore is ahead and recharge material lies nearby.

action.zh: 你暂时绕去采充电材料，补满工具后再回到目标。
action.en: Detour for recharge material, refill the tool, then return to the objective.

result.zh: 这次没有直接推进任务，却延长了可持续工作的时间。
result.en: The detour did not directly advance the objective, but extended your working time.

next.zh: 每隔一段路检查余量，避免到目标面前才断电。
next.en: Check reserves along the route rather than running out at the next target.

firstStep.zh: 做目标矿与能源矿两类节点、一个电量条和明确的采矿耗能。
firstStep.en: Use objective and energy deposits, one charge gauge and a clear mining energy cost.

pitfall.zh: 补能过程若消耗比产出还大又没有替代路径，会形成无法恢复的死循环。
pitfall.en: If refuelling costs more than it yields and no alternative exists, players can enter an unrecoverable loop.

test.zh: 玩家能否提前补能，并根据距离选择带多少储备，而非总被耗尽提示赶着走？
test.en: Can players refuel proactively and budget reserves for distance rather than only reacting to an empty gauge?
